hero_subtitle: A fast and reliable tool helping Egyptian growers and agronomists detect foliage diseases early to protect crop yield and quality.
feature_accurate_desc: Trained with priority weighting on real-world field imagery and conservative rejection of uncertain samples.
feature_fast_desc: Instant diagnosis in under 200ms on ordinary CPUs without needing expensive cloud GPUs.
feature_bilingual_desc: Clean Arabic and English interface with curated cultural recommendations for field and academic use.
supported_crops_subtitle: The system currently supports 30 categories covering essential Egyptian strategic crops:
footer_disclaimer: Notice: This application is an educational and advisory tool. Always consult a qualified agronomist before applying treatments.
footer_copyright: Smart Agri Assistant © 2026 — Arab Open University Graduation Project
diagnose_subtitle: Take a clear close-up photo of the suspected leaf to receive instant diagnosis and practical cultural recommendations.
upload_drop_zone: Drag and drop leaf photo here, or click to browse
upload_or_browse: or browse files from your device
upload_hint: Supported formats: JPG, PNG, WEBP (Max size 8 MB)
photo_tip_1: Frame a single leaf clearly so it fills most of the photo.
photo_tip_2: Use natural daylight and avoid deep dark shadows or blur.
photo_tip_3: Avoid crowded backgrounds like hands, tools, or excessive soil.
loading_desc: The model is inspecting leaf features against trained disease patterns.
status_ok_desc: Model confidence exceeded the validated decision threshold.
status_uncertain_desc: Model confidence is below the calibrated threshold. Please retake photo with better lighting or consult an agronomist.
status_unknown_desc: The uploaded photo does not appear to show a recognized crop leaf.
status_bad_image_desc: The file could not be decoded as an image or is smaller than the required 100px minimum side.
reliability_warning_title: Important Reliability Notice for this Class:
reliability_low_recall_desc: This disease exhibited below 60% recall in real-field evaluation due to symptom overlap with other conditions. Field verification by an agronomist is strongly advised.
reliability_lab_only_desc: This class was trained predominantly on laboratory imagery due to scarce field samples. Performance under open field conditions may vary.
advisory_notice: Information presented is advisory only and cannot substitute on-site inspection by an agricultural professional.
err_file_too_large: Image file size exceeds the 8 MB maximum limit.
err_image_too_small: Image resolution is too small (minimum 100 pixels).
err_bad_image: The uploaded file is corrupt or not a recognized image format.
err_unsupported_media_type: Unsupported file type. Please upload an image only.
err_network_error: Cannot connect to server. Please check your internet connection.
err_internal_server_error: An unexpected error occurred while processing the image.
